name: events
_comment_purpose: One row per action on an invoice, appended by the tool that made it in the same run: submit_invoice (`submitted`, `resubmitted`, actor the requester), review_invoice (`reviewed`, actor `agent`, with the clamped `recommendation`), decide_invoice (`approved`, `rejected`, `returned`, actor `approver`, with the operator's `note`), and the seed and reset (`seeded`, `reset`, actor `system`; `reset` has no invoice). `revision` is the invoice revision the event belongs to. The chat agent reads this store to answer history questions; the UI renders it as the History tab and the invoice timeline. Rows are never edited.
